name: web-debug
description: Evidence-first local web debugging that complements frontend build and test workflows with bounded browser evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Reproduce local web bugs with bounded evidence.
interface.longDescription: Inspect and repair a running local web app through exact locator probes, guarded loopback TLS, disposable auth, computed accessibility, named checkpoints, bounded viewport matrices, React, Angular, Vue, Vite, Next.js, Safari, debugger, replay, and fix-verification evidence. Auth-seeded screenshots are suppressed; Safari remains CSS-only for advanced capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Use Web Debug to reproduce this local browser bug and capture evidence.
Inspect this React, Angular, Vue, Vite, or Next.js runtime issue with Web Debug.
Verify this frontend fix against a recorded Web Debug flow.
Use Web Debug to diagnose responsive geometry at desktop and mobile sizes.
Compare deterministic test evidence with Web Debug browser evidence.
Diagnose this flow with Web Debug semantic locators and named checkpoints.
